sn37.32:1.1: Pañcimāni bhikkhave ṭhānāni dullabhāni akatapuññena mātugāmena ||
sn37.32:1.4: idam bhikkhave pathamaṃ ṭhānaṃ dullabhaṃ akatapuññena mātugāmena || ||
sn37.32:1.5: Patirūpe kule jāyitvā patirūpaṃ kulaṃ gaccheyyan ti ||
sn37.32:1.6: idam bhikkhave dutiyaṃ ṭhānam dullabham akatapuññena mātugāmena || ||
sn37.32:1.7: Patirūpe kule jāyitvā patirūpaṃ kulam gantvā asapattī agāram ajjhāvaseyyan ti ||
sn37.32:1.8: idam bhikkhave tatiyaṃ ṭhānaṃ dullabham akatapuññena mātugāmena || ||
sn37.32:1.9: Patirūpe kule jāyitvā patirūpaṃ kulaṃ gantvā asapattī agāram ajjhāvasantī puttavatī assan ti ||
sn37.32:1.10: idam bhikkhave catutthaṃ ṭhānaṃ dullabham akatapuññena mātugāmena || ||
sn37.32:1.11: Patirūpe kule jāyitvā patirūpaṃ kulaṃ gantvā asapattī agāram ajjhāvasantī puttavatī samānā sāmikam abhibhuyya vatteyyanti ||
sn37.32:1.12: idam bhikkhave pañcamaṃ ṭhānaṃ dullabham akatapuññena mātugāmena || ||
sn37.32:1.13: Imāni kho bhikkhave pañcaṭṭhānāni dullabhāni akatapuññena mātugāmena || || 4
